nodes.name: prefetch.rs
nodes.summary: Implements TurnPrefetchHook, which kicks off skill-listing and memory-surfacing lookups concurrently at the start of a turn so their results are ready by the time the prompt is built, hiding their latency.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a TurnPrefetchHook wrapping already-spawned skill and memory prefetch tasks along with any pre-known memory surface state.

nodes.name: test_with_delayed_outputs
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a TurnPrefetchHook whose prefetch tasks resolve after an artificial delay, used to exercise prefetch-timing edge cases.

nodes.name: abort_pending
nodes.summary: Aborts any still-running skill/memory prefetch tasks, used when a turn is cancelled before prefetch completes.

nodes.name: collect_skill
nodes.summary: Awaits, up to a max wait, the skill-listing prefetch task and returns its rendered section for injection into the prompt.

nodes.name: collect_memory
nodes.summary: Awaits the memory-surfacing prefetch task and returns its rendered section plus the paths it surfaced.

nodes.name: before_llm_iteration
nodes.summary: Hook invoked before each LLM iteration to inject any prefetch results that have become available since the turn started.

nodes.name: start_turn_prefetch
nodes.summary: Kicks off the skill and memory prefetch tasks concurrently at the start of a turn so their results are ready, or nearly ready, by the time the prompt is built.

nodes.name: start_skill_prefetch_task
nodes.summary: Spawns the async task that looks up and renders the relevant skill listing for the incoming message.

nodes.name: start_memory_prefetch_task
nodes.summary: Spawns the async task that surfaces relevant memory entries for the incoming message and conversation history.

nodes.name: prepend_to_last_user_message
nodes.summary: Prepends a prefix string onto the content of the most recent user message in the history.

nodes.name: insert_system_after_existing_system
nodes.summary: Inserts a new system message immediately after the existing leading system message(s) in the history.

nodes.name: TurnPrefetchHook
nodes.summary: Owns the concurrently-running skill and memory prefetch tasks for a turn and exposes hooks to collect their results or abort them mid-flight.

nodes.name: prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Assembles the static system prompt and per-turn dynamic prompt sections — prefetched memory, skills, IDE/presence context and the current user message — for a session's turn.

nodes.name: render_linked_work_item_context
nodes.summary: Renders a short context block describing a linked work item or ticket for inclusion in the system prompt.

nodes.name: build_system_prompt
nodes.summary: Assembles the full static system prompt for a session from its configured identity, rules, tools and workspace sections.

nodes.name: build_dynamic_sections
nodes.summary: Assembles the per-turn dynamic prompt sections, including prefetched memory, skills, IDE/presence context and the current user message, appended after the static system prompt.

nodes.name: rounds_since_tool
nodes.summary: Computes how many turn rounds have elapsed since a given tool was last used, used to drive periodic reminder injections.

nodes.name: streaming.rs
nodes.summary: Defines StreamingError/StreamingErrorCode for classifying provider streaming failures, and broadcasts agent-complete, agent-error and agent-warning events to the frontend.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a StreamingError with a message and a classified StreamingErrorCode.

nodes.name: with_details
nodes.summary: Attaches extra diagnostic details to a StreamingError, returning the enriched error.

nodes.name: is_retryable
nodes.summary: Reports whether this class of streaming error is safe to automatically retry.

nodes.name: wire_value
nodes.summary: Returns the stable string identifier for a StreamingErrorCode sent to the frontend over the wire.

nodes.name: classify_streaming_error_message
nodes.summary: Classifies a raw provider error message string into a StreamingErrorCode such as auth, rate-limit, overload or network.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a lower-level provider/transport error into a StreamingError, preserving its classification.

nodes.name: is_file_modifying_tool
nodes.summary: Reports whether a tool name is known to modify files on disk, used to decide whether to trigger snapshot/refresh logic.

nodes.name: broadcast_agent_complete
nodes.summary: Broadcasts the agent-turn-complete event to the frontend with the final content, token usage and context snapshot.

nodes.name: broadcast_agent_error_structured
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a structured StreamingError to the frontend so the UI can render an appropriate error state.

nodes.name: broadcast_agent_warning
nodes.summary: Broadcasts a non-fatal warning event to the frontend, tagged with its originating source.

nodes.name: StreamingError
nodes.summary: Structured error type for streaming/provider failures, carrying a message, classified error code, retryability flag and optional details.

nodes.name: StreamingErrorCode
nodes.summary: Enumerates the classes of streaming failure, such as auth, rate limit, overload, network and context overflow, with retryability and wire-format helpers.

nodes.name: AgentCompleteParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for broadcasting a completed turn: session/turn ids, content, model, token counts and context usage snapshot.

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the data types describing turn input context and user-presence state: ProcessingContext, UserPresence, IdeContext, SystemPromptConfig and related DTOs.

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the stable string form of a PresenceStance variant, such as Interactive, DeferAndBatch or Autonomous.

nodes.name: display_label
nodes.summary: Returns the UI-facing display label for the current user-presence mode.

nodes.name: ProcessingContext
nodes.summary: Carries per-message processing context, including attached images, resume flag, display text and turn/turn-intent ids, through the turn pipeline.

nodes.name: PresenceStance
nodes.summary: Enumerates how the agent should behave relative to a present-or-away user: interactive, defer-and-batch, or fully autonomous.

nodes.name: UserPresence
nodes.summary: Describes the user's current presence mode, label, expected return time, stance and auto-resolve/auto-approve timeout settings.

nodes.name: UserProfile
nodes.summary: Describes the user's profile, including name, tech-savviness, job roles, familiar tech stacks and a free-text description, used to tailor agent behavior.

nodes.name: IdeContext
nodes.summary: Snapshots the connected IDE's state, including open files, active file/selection/cursor, terminal context, lint errors, git status and workspace folders, plus embedded user presence/profile.

nodes.name: ProcessingResult
nodes.summary: Result of processing a turn: final content, token counts, tool-call count, truncation flag, turn summary and optional fork-redirect outcome.

nodes.name: ToolSummary
nodes.summary: A tool's name and description, used when summarizing available tools in the prompt.

nodes.name: SystemPromptConfig
nodes.summary: Full configuration needed to build a session's system prompt: model, agent identity, skills, workspace/resource loading flags, agent-org context and sovereign-prompt settings.

nodes.name: enums.rs
nodes.summary: Defines SessionStatus and AgentExecMode, the core lifecycle and execution-mode enums used throughout session management, with parse/serialize helpers.

nodes.name: as_str
nodes.summary: Returns the stable string form of an enum variant, implemented separately for SessionStatus (its lowercase wire status) and AgentExecMode (Build/Ask/Plan/Debug/Review/Wingman), used for persistence and API responses.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses an enum value from its stable string representation, implemented separately for SessionStatus and AgentExecMode, used when loading persisted session records and exec-mode settings.

nodes.name: is_terminal
nodes.summary: Reports whether a SessionStatus represents a terminal state, such as Completed, Failed, Cancelled, Abandoned, Timeout or Archived, after which the session no longer runs.

nodes.name: is_active
nodes.summary: Reports whether a SessionStatus represents an actively-running state.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a raw value into a SessionStatus, defaulting sensibly for unrecognized input.

nodes.name: SessionStatus
nodes.summary: Enumerates a session's lifecycle states, such as Pending, Idle, Running, WaitingForUser, Paused, Completed, Failed, Cancelled, Abandoned, Timeout and Archived, with parse/serialize and terminal/active helpers.

nodes.name: AgentExecMode
nodes.summary: Enumerates the agent's execution mode, such as Build, Ask, Plan, Debug, Review and Wingman, governing which behaviors and tools are active.

nodes.name: filter.rs
nodes.summary: Tiny stub module reserved for session-related filter type definitions.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the session types submodules (context, enums, filter, turn) as a single import surface.
